race.description: Peter Tobin Funerals F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: ENDEMIC (8) finished third last time over 1500m at this track, beaten one length. Was well-backed that day after a good debut third at a big price and she should be ready to go now. LATASSA (4) is a three-start maiden who is well and truly overdue, finishing second at Pakenham Synthetic over 1600m last time out when it took a smart one to beat her. Chances enhanced significantly from the inside draw. STAR JE TAIME (14) closed off strongly last start to get up for third, beaten just under a length over 1454m at Kyneton. Can go on with it at peak fitness from the great draw. DAME OF DUBAI (1) can only be better for the debut outing, suited by the rise in grade and looks favoured by the draw. ENTICEMENT (9) stepped out on her debut over 1500m at this track two weeks ago and finished fifth, beaten 2.5 lengths, and is also drawn well.
